alt: A short film with no voice. Night sky on a flat dark-blue field with a large smooth moon, flat nebula shapes and twinkling stars; a short comet crosses once, low and to the left. Two small block figures with doorway legs and white eyes, one amber and one light blue, sit side by side on a low wall, looking up. Three lines stay on screen from the first frame: if you're seeing this, go see the moon, with someone you love. The two figures lean together with happy eyes.
